headline: Shelf Price Cuts: 686 Branded Codes, Another 230 for School Products and Private Label Products
summary: A national shelf price reduction initiative covers 686 branded product codes and another 230 for school and private label products. New companies are set to join the programme.
why: Shelf price cuts affect retail margins and household consumer prices, which feed into inflation measures tracked by investors. Retail chains and suppliers are the businesses most directly exposed.
